_comment: ShipStation SKU → Prosol API SKU mapping. Used by order router to place POs. CRITICAL: verified against live Prosol API 2026-03-17.

_notes.format: api_sku = what filter[sku] needs for Prosol API lookups. prosol_sku = real Prosol SKU for PO placement.
_notes.sku_patterns: Quarts: api_sku ends in -4 (e.g. C010382-4). Gallons: api_sku is just the base number (e.g. C010383). Pints: base number only. Each size has a DIFFERENT base number.
_notes.bundles: Array of {api_sku, prosol_sku} objects for multi-product bundles
_notes.NON_PROSOL: Products not available through Prosol — source elsewhere
_notes.UNMAPPED: Could not find in Prosol API — needs manual verification
_notes.SKIP: Not real products (discount codes, custom items)
_notes.package_shape: Shipping package classification. 'solo' = ships alone (qty N → N packages). 'roll_kerdi' = KERDI waterproofing membrane rolls, tape together up to max_per_pkg (5). 'heat_sheet' = DITRA-HEAT/DUO/PS sheets, combine up to max_pkg_weight_lb (50 lb). Absence = default (combine with other default items in one box).
_notes.max_per_pkg: Max units of this SKU per package (used with roll_kerdi)
_notes.max_pkg_weight_lb: Max package weight in lb when combining (used with heat_sheet)
